description: Shell script for managing power modes by performing orderly shutdown and startup of RDKB CCSP components, including functions for usage display, component teardown, and startup based on power mode arguments.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions based on support and model conditions.

methods.name: PwrMgr_TearDownComponents
methods.description: Performs an orderly shutdown of specific RDKB components.

methods.name: PwrMgr_StartupComponents
methods.description: Performs an orderly startup of specific RDKB components.
